label: third original token (t=2), boosted by b/f earlier or f/j at t=2
explanation: Position-locked unit: fires only in the original phase, and 95% of activation mass is at t=2 (the third original token), with small spillover at t=1 and t=3. It never fires at t=0, on the delimiter, or in the copy phase. At t=2 it fires on only about 12% of steps, so t==2 alone has recall 0.93 but precision 0.12. Whether it fires, and how strongly, depends additively on token identity. It is stronger when b or f appears earlier (first_tok b gives 7x lift, prev2 b 8.5x) and when the current token is f or j (in_tok f 5.4x). The top activations are sequences like b b [f], b f [f], f b [f], b b [j]. Requiring b/f in the prefix or f/j as the current token gets about 0.81 of activation mass at precision about 0.43. The remaining activations come from many other token combinations, each contributing a little, which a simple predicate cannot capture.
